parameters.content:
### Private issuance only
Caller must resolve the canonical Airtable client internally. Input: clientRecordId and expiresAt (maximum 366 days). Returns a one-time token and grantId; only its SHA-256 digest is stored.
Disable execution payload persistence on every caller. Revoke a grant by setting revokedAt in schulzePortalGrants. No public issuance webhook.
